redTeamGate.$comment: source: both (standard default), check-run (cutover), or drain-scan (rollback). Resolves standard -> platform -> tool -> WE_RED_TEAM_GATE_SOURCE; invalid values are ignored and logged. Check-run recovery waits drain.redTeamPendingMaxMin, then requests once per live head through requestRedTeam, durable before dispatch.

redTeam.$comment: statusLabels defaults true (WE_RED_TEAM_STATUS_LABELS override); head-bound derived status only, recorded results remain authoritative. skipCardOnly defaults true; card-only net diffs never schedule a pass.

operatorRulings.$comment: anyState (default false; opt in with this setting or WE_RED_TEAM_OPERATOR_RULINGS_ANY_STATE=true): a human operator's record-red-team-ruling may rule card on any confirmed break of the live head's result (at the cap, sent back, or carded). Default = round-cap-only; pending round extensions remain owned by automation.
